questions.prompt: Put the assembly stages in order.
items: Prepare the workspace and ground yourself
Install CPU, M.2, RAM and cooler on the motherboard
Fit standoffs, I/O shield and PSU in the case
Power on and check the UEFI
questions.explanation: Building the board outside the case first is easier and safer.

questions.prompt: The fans spin but there is no display, and you see the 8-pin CPU header is empty. What is wrong?
questions.explanation: Without the 8-pin EPS cable, the CPU does not get power.

questions.prompt: Why match the standoffs to the motherboard's holes?
choices: An extra standoff can short the back of the board
questions.explanation: Metal standoffs under the board where there is no hole can cause short circuits.

questions.prompt: What should you check in the UEFI after the first start? Select all that apply.
questions.explanation: The UEFI confirms the hardware works before installing the operating system.

questions.prompt: The power button works but the case's power light does not. What is the likely cause?
choices: The power LED wires are reversed on the front-panel header
